knowledge:
- key_parameters: cpgsitefile=path to the extended read file (e.g., .txt) ;; allcpgfile=CpG site file containing single CpG information ;; category=category identifier (e.g., "1") ;; datafile=matrix or data frame combining MeDIP-seq and MRE-seq counts for control and treatment samples ;; cpgfile=all CpG site bin file ;; mrecpgfile=MRE CpG site file ;; mreratio=ratio of MRE-seq to MeDIP-seq (e.g., 3/7) ;; psd=pseudo count parameter (e.g., 2) ;; mkadded=added marker parameter (e.g., 1) ;; f=f parameter (e.g., 1)
- alternatives: methylMnM (mentioned for initial data pre-processing steps before running SIMD)
- when_to_use: Joint analysis of MeDIP-seq and MRE-seq data to identify differentially methylated CpG sites.
- pitfalls: Input files must be in a specific BED-like format; MRE-seq data strictly requires "+" and "-" strand information in the mapping process (typically the 6th column). R version must be > 3.5.0.

workflows.name: simd_differential_methylation_analysis
workflows.intent: Jointly analyze MeDIP-seq and MRE-seq data to calculate CpG site-specific p-values and identify differentially methylated regions.
input: example_data.RData (RData containing pre-processed CpG and MRE site files)
workflows.stages: 1. Run EMalgorithm to infer actual short reads from observed fragments for each sample ;; 2. Combine the inferred MeDIP-seq and MRE-seq counts for control and treatment samples ;; 3. Run EMtest to calculate p-values for each CpG site
workflows.code:
library(SIMD)
datafile <- system.file("extdata", package="methylMnM")
filepath <- datafile[1]
dirwrite <- paste(setwd(getwd()), "/", sep="")
data(example_data)
allcpgfile <- EM_H1ESB1_MeDIP_sigleCpG
readshort <- paste(filepath, "/H1ESB1_MeDIP_18.extended.txt", sep="")
writefile <- paste(dirwrite, "EM2_H1ESB1_MeDIP_sigleCpG.bed", sep="")
reportfile <- paste(dirwrite, "EM2_H1ESB1_MeDIP_sigleCpG_report.bed", sep="")
EMalgorithm(cpgsitefile=readshort, allcpgfile=allcpgfile, category="1",
            writefile=writefile, reportfile=reportfile)
data(example_data)
data1 <- EM2_H1ESB1_MeDIP_sigleCpG
data2 <- EM2_H1ESB2_MeDIP_sigleCpG
data3 <- H1ESB1_MRE_sigleCpG
data4 <- H1ESB2_MRE_sigleCpG
datafile <- cbind(data1,data2,data3,data4)
allcpg <- all_CpGsite_bin_chr18
mrecpg <- three_mre_cpg
dirwrite <-paste(setwd(getwd()), "/", sep="")
writefile <- paste(dirwrite, "pval_EM_H1ESB1_H1ESB21.bed", sep="")
reportfile <- paste(dirwrite, "report_pvalH1ESB1_H1ESB21.bed", sep="")
EMtest(datafile=datafile, chrstring=NULL, cpgfile=allcpg,mrecpgfile=mrecpg, 
       writefile=writefile, reportfile=reportfile,mreratio=3/7, psd=2, 
       mkadded=1, f=1)
